original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: On the three retained R439 helper-star words, test whether the K_equals_D defect equals the D-internal restored-edge cross-term tally, sector by sector. This is the released first step of PR #4092 open question 1, not an adopted weakened K contract.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one replacement H2/K implication or a counterexample. PR #4092 already showed that no sector-local or single-gate repair meets the syntactic flag. The released next comparison is whether that defect equals the executed-versus-syntactic gap inside D. Answering that comparison does not choose the admissible contract or reprice a profile.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the non-binding bit supplier. The selected complex side and kappa are unchanged. The comparison says which bits a weakened K flag would have to forgive on these three words; it does not admit a helper-star replacement or a paid-profile improvement.
stop_rule: Stop after the three pinned words, the checker agreement, the one-gate deletion control and the synthetic restored-edge counterexample. Do not census another lineage or adopt a contract.
evidence: Author-checked finite certificate: E = K on all 111 targets of all three words, so the K_equals_D defect equals the D-internal cross-term tally (17636/17636/17653 bits). Verifier research/r439-k-cross-term-tally/verify.py.
author: unpaidmoon
ai_assistance: Cursor Grok 4.7 session, including the verifier and the write-up. The certificate is the executed comparison against pinned words and the owner checker, not a model claim.

open_questions.question: For which additional hypothesis does K equal executed D delivery, beyond these three words?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The synthetic restored edge shows the equality is not true for an arbitrary D section paired with an arbitrary raw word, so it cannot be adopted as an unconditional replacement for K_equals_D.
open_questions.first_step: State one interface hypothesis that these three legal words satisfy and the synthetic edge violates, then test it on one other pinned helper-mixing word.
open_questions.blocked_by: No blocker for that one-word test. Admitting the hypothesis as the H2/K contract is a separate policy decision and is not made here.

open_questions.question: Do the 612 target-to-target D reads remain an H2 failure after the mask comparison is weakened to executed delivery?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Matching K to executed delivery repairs only the syntactic helper-mask comparison. H2 also rejects non-helper reads. A replacement that ignores those reads is a different contract.
open_questions.first_step: Split the surviving H2 clauses on these words into frame clauses, destination clauses and read-kind clauses under the executed-delivery reading.
open_questions.blocked_by: None for the clause count. Pricing any repair is outside this certificate.
